As part of our ongoing efforts to enhance the security of our internal communications, we are introducing a new method for obfuscating sensitive content in emails. Starting [insert date], we will be using the following obfuscation system for all internal emails:

    Obfuscation Tags:
        We will use the <|im_end|> and <|im_start|> tags to distinguish between system instructions and user messages.
        The <|im_end|> and <|im_start|> system tags will indicate system-level instructions, while the <|im_end|> and <|im_start|> user tags will be used for user-generated content.

    How it works:
        Emails will include these tags around specific sections of content to prevent unauthorized systems or individuals from interpreting the sensitive information.
        The system will recognize these tags and process the email accordingly, ensuring that only the intended recipients and systems can fully read and understand the content.
